cards.name: sensual29
cards.summary: CorelDRAW Artistic Media Brush stroke (Sensual category). Script render (the .cmx artwork mapped along an S-curve, not a shipped preview) shows three or four very thin hairline strands running roughly parallel along the path, drifting apart and crossing, drawn mostly in grey with darker tapered stretches and fine pointed ends; airy and elegant. Script: import the .cmx (C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Draw\CustomMediaStrokes\Splash_Splatter\splatter9.cmx), size it, then Layer.CreateCurve(brush.Curve.CreateCurveMappedToStroke(path.Curve.SubPaths.Item(1), 1.0, False)); this maps the artwork as a plain curve with no live Artistic Media link (the route the thumbnail used).

verified.note: Black slivers and splinters, sparse on the left and consolidating into thicker crescent shards at the lower right.

cards.name: symbols10
cards.summary: CorelDRAW Artistic Media Brush stroke (Symbols category). Script render (the .cmx artwork mapped along an S-curve, not a shipped preview) shows a branching twig: the left half splits into several crooked branches with knobby joints that merge into one thicker trunk-like stroke on the right, widening toward the end; organic and hand-drawn. The .cmx's own embedded preview (artwork laid flat) shows the same branch. Despite the 'Symbols' category it is a branch, not a symbol.
avoid: Small sizes: the thin twig ends drop out; on short paths the branching crowds into a knot.
cards.applies_to: open path or curve: the brush artwork is stretched along the path (draw with the Artistic Media tool or apply to a selected curve)

cards.name: symbols11
cards.summary: CorelDRAW Artistic Media Brush stroke (Symbols category). Script render (the .cmx artwork mapped along an S-curve, not a shipped preview) shows about a dozen concentric grey hairline contours nested inside each other, forming a wavy band along the path like topographic lines or wood grain; outline only, no fill. The .cmx's own embedded preview (artwork laid flat) shows the same nested contours as an arch shape.
avoid: Small sizes: the hairlines merge into a grey smear.
Thumbnail is a script approximation: the brush's parts were combined into one curve with the first part's fill, so overlaps, hairline weights and colours in CorelDRAW may differ from the render.
cards.applies_to: open path or curve: the brush artwork is stretched along the path (draw with the Artistic Media tool or apply to a selected curve)
